comparison_identity.comparator: range with one endpoint qualifier versus the shortest careful English stating both endpoint memberships

manifest.selection: All eight complete pairs were authored and frozen before tokenizer import; the set is balanced two per marker and every English arm is a short natural rendering that fixes both endpoint-membership bits.
manifest.method: tokens(Ainglish) minus tokens(English) per complete pair; equal item mean per tokenizer; maximum tokenizer mean as least-favourable headline; member range as interval
manifest.scope: Deterministic token cost for this frozen shortest-careful-English population only; not comprehension, corruption, fidelity, adoption, or range-validity evidence.

token_derivation.scope: Recounted submitted text and arithmetic only; not comparator adequacy, independent replication, comprehension, or future-trained efficiency.
